cards.text:
DZ-PS03/001EN
White Lily Musketeer, Cecilia
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 10000｜ Shield
[ACT](VC)[1/turn][Limit-Break 4]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & put five normal units with "Musketeer" in their card names from drop on the bottom of the deck in any order], search your deck for up to two "White Lily Musketeer, Cecilia", call them to (RC), and shuffle the deck.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Retire a rear-guard with "Musketeer" in its card name], look at up to five cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one card with "Musketeer" in its card name from among them, call it to (RC), and shuffle the deck.

DZ-PS03/002EN
Thorn Lily Musketeer, Cecilia "Яeverse"
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & retire two rear-guards], look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to two unit cards from among them, call them to (RC), and shuffle the deck.
[AUTO](VC)/Front Row (RC)[1/turn]:At the end of the battle your rear-guard with "Cecilia" in its card name that was placed from deck this turn attacked a grade 3 or greater vanguard, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & lock two [Stand] rear-guards], and [Stand] the unit that attacked. If your front row has a locked card, bind it instead of [Stand] it, and ride that card on your vanguard with "Musketeer" in its card name as [Stand].

DZ-PS03/003EN
Peony Musketeer, Martina
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1 & retire a rear-guard], look at the top five cards of your deck, choose a card from among them, call it to (RC), and shuffle the deck.
[CONT](RC):During the turn this unit was placed from the deck, this unit gets [Power] +5000/[Critical] +1.

DZ-PS03/004EN
Lycoris Musketeer, Vera
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & retire two rear-guards], choose two cards from your drop, put them on the bottom of the deck in any order, look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to two unit cards from among them, call them to (RC), and shuffle the deck. If you called two cards with "Musketeer" in their card names, this unit gets drive +1 until end of turn.
[CONT](VC):If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, and your front row has "Lycoris Musketeer, Saul", all of your front row rear-guards get the [Power] this unit had got from trigger effects.

DZ-PS03/005EN
Pansy Musketeer, Sylvia
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), you may call a plant token to (RC).

DZ-PS03/006EN
Peony Musketeer, Toure
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & retire a rear-guard], look at the top three cards of your deck, choose two cards with "Musketeer" in their card names or any one card from among them, call them to (RC), and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order.

DZ-PS03/007EN
Lycoris Musketeer, Saul
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), if you have a vanguard with "Musketeer" in its card name, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & retire a rear-guard], look at the top three cards of your deck, choose up to one unit card from among them, call it to (RC), and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order. If you called a trigger unit, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and activate all of that card's trigger effects.

DZ-PS03/008EN
Water Lily Musketeer, Ruth
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), call up to one plant token to (RC). If your opponent's vanguard is grade 1 or greater, call up to two instead of one.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit or your other unit is placed on (RC) from deck, [COST][retire this unit], and [Counter-Charge 1].

DZ-PS03/009EN
Dandelion Musketeer, Mirkka
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and call a plant token to a (RC) in the same column as this unit.
[AUTO](RC):When your other unit is placed on (RC) in the same column as this unit, this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of turn.

Anthurium Musketeer, Gastone
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000

DZ-PS03/011EN
Broccolini Musketeer, Kirah
Normal Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, draw a card. Then, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 1 or greater, put a Quick Shield ticket into hand.

DZ-PS03/012EN
Source Dragon Deity of Blessings, Blessfavor
Trigger Unit｜ Stoicheia｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Draw a card! Choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] +1 until end of turn! All of your front row units get [Power] +10000! If your damage zone has the same number of cards as your opponent's or more, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!

Happy Lucky
Trigger Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 0｜ Power 4000｜ Shield 0
[AUTO](RC)[Generation Break 1]:When your vanguard attacks, [COST][put this unit into soul], draw a card, choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle.

Maiden of Polyantha
Trigger Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 0｜ Power 4000｜ Shield 0
[CONT](Hand):While you are paying the cost for [Stride], this card may be discarded as a grade 3.

Maiden of Blossom Rain
Trigger Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (GC), [COST][discard a card from hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

DZ-PS03/016EN
Pure-hearted Flower Maiden, Fiorenza
Trigger Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 3｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 15000
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC) from hand, if you did not ride a grade 3 or greater unit this fight, perform one of the following.
・Choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
・Choose one of your opponent's units, and it gets [Critical] -2 until end of that battle.
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, if your damage zone has no cards, put the top card of your deck into the damage zone.

DZ-PS03/017EN
Elementaria Sanctitude
Blitz Order｜ -｜ Grade 1｜ Power ｜ Shield
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[CONT]:You may only have one "Elementaria Sanctitude" in a deck.
If your opponent's vanguard has "Triple Drive", this ability can be played without paying the cost.
Play this with [COST][discard a card from hand] if your vanguard is grade 3 or less!
Choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. Remove this card.

DZ-PS03/018EN
Harmonics Messiah
G Unit｜ ｜ Grade 4｜ Power 16000+｜ Shield
[CONT]:You may only have one "Harmonics Messiah" G Unit in a G deck.
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), choose any number of your locked cards, and unlock them. Choose the same number of cards from your hand as the number of cards unlocked by this effect, and discard them.
[AUTO](VC)/G Zone:When this unit is placed on (VC), or at the beginning of your turn, if this card is face up, your damage zone has two or less cards, and no new card was put into your damage zone during your opponent's preceding turn, [COST][put the top card of the deck into damage zone], and draw a card.
[AUTO]G Zone:When your grade 1 unit is placed by riding from a grade 0, if you went second, [COST][reveal this card], and put a Guardian Shield ticket into your hand.

DZ-PS03/019EN
Maiden Lily Musketeer Captain, Virginal Cecilia
G Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000+｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[ACT]G zone:If your vanguard is a grade 3 "White Lily Musketeer, Cecilia" with the [Limit-Break 4] ability, and you did not get an imaginary gift this fight, [COST][choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down. Then, [COST][turn a card with "Musketeer" in its card name from G zone face up], you get two Imaginary Gift:Force, and you get a "White Lily Musketeer, Cecilia" crest.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & turn a card with the same card name as this unit from G zone face up], choose up to five of your rear-guards, and retire them. Look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to the same number of cards with "Musketeer" in their card names as the number of units retired by this effect from among them, call them to (RC), and they get [Power] +3000 until end of turn for each face up card in your G zone with "Musketeer" in their card names. Shuffle the deck.

[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Discard a card from hand], choose one of your rear-guards, search your deck for up to two cards with the same grade as that rear-guard and reveal them, choose up to one card from among them, put it into hand, call the rest to (RC), and shuffle the deck.

G Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000+｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), [COST][turn a card from G zone face up], call up to the same number of plant tokens as the number of face up cards in your G zone to (RC), and this unit gets "[CONT](VC):All of your plant tokens get [Power] +10000." until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, search your deck for up to the same number of cards as the number of your plant tokens, call them to (RC), and shuffle the deck.

White Lily Musketeer Captain, Cecilia
G Unit｜ Neo Nectar｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000+｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards from hand with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater, and discard them], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.

Shuffle the deck.

Others｜ -｜ Grade ｜ Power ｜ Shield

[CONT]:The original [Power] of your grade 3 cards with the [Limit-Break 4] ability become 13000. (Including heart cards)
